summary: Santa Monica Community College District found on May 14, 2026 that employee W-2 forms, with names and Social Security numbers, had been emailed to two former student workers, with the information exposed from April 13 to May 21, 2026. The college confirmed the email was deleted, found no evidence of misuse and offered affected employees credit monitoring.
